task2.my: Well, I changed my computer. Uh, it's one of my biggest uh purchases recently uh for two reasons. Uh, first one, uh, I have a better computer. task2.q: When you make a purchase, do you usually plan ahead or do you buy things spontaneously? Why?
task2.my: Well, it depends. If the purchase is very big, I usually plan it ahead, such as buying computers and renting a house and buy some big things, just for example, over two thousand yuan. If some little things, such as a meal, some food, don't need to plan much often, and it give me freedom to use it, and it save my time to do other things.

model2.en: it depends on how big the purchase is.
for big purchases, I always plan ahead.

I compare prices and save up first.

task2.q: When you decide whether to buy something, which matters more to you: getting good value for your money, or spending as little as possible? Why?
task2.my: Well, I usually do a monthly plan with my money. I will get a schedule about my spending. I picked several important things in the month, such as I have to change my computer in the month, and I should spend less on other things in that month. With that plan, I really know how much money I spend and how to make better use of my money.

model2.en: good value matters more to me than lowest price.
value means the thing lasts and works well.
cheap things often break fast.
a good computer costs more but serves me years.
in the end it saves me more money.

task2.q: Do you think people will increasingly rely on financial apps and tools to manage their money, or will people prefer to hire personal financial managers? Explain your thoughts.
task2.my: Well, I think people will more use uh the apps online to uh manage their financial events. The first is very convenient and uh less expensive, and these can use on your own and you can adjust your plan with your uh own at any time. If you want, uh you can write down everything and adjust the time. And the second, uh I don't think uh consult professional people is very uh common.
